main.description: Images with an external link or a quoted post. At most eight images total across both galleries. Comments allow only a quoted-post attachment.

view.description: Images and attachment as served by the AppView. Image URLs are projected from blob references; Coves quotes retain only their strong reference. Every #image placement in the served record resolves to an image in the main images gallery, never the attachment. Images without a placement render as a gallery after the body.
